source: 私有化批次 A/B 之后的产品面（产品身份 = glasspane-harness）；lineage 计数改为不含 packages/opencode 这个目录名（它是树里的真实路径，manifest/fixture/tool 参数都必须正确引用它，而 ratchet 分不清它与一次泄出的改名）——2026-09-26 七个新增全部属于这一类。｜2026-09-28 记 9616：新增的 opencode 字样全部出现在「断言它不存在」的位置（not.toContain）与解释为何删掉它的注释里，ratchet 按字面计数分不清这两者；同一批把 presentation.ts 里真正的泄露改掉，净增 1。反证仍然成立：把命令名改回 opencode 会转红。｜2026-09-30 记 9617（+1，来自 1815731「11 个类型错误清零 + 三个真缺陷」）：那一批把 presentation.ts 里用户可见的 `opencode -s <id>` 改成 `glasspane-harness -s <id>`（真正的泄露，修掉了），同时在同文件加了一段解释该改动的注释，注释里出现 opencode 字样，按字面计数净增 1。与 9616 同类：字样出现在「说明它已被改掉」的位置，不是产品面重新漏出。反证仍成立。

rules.why: the upstream npm package name is not installable as *this* product; a user following it gets opencode (@opencode-ai/* workspace scopes are kept bloodline)
platform packages are named after the product (product.json → platformPackage)
those endpoints belong to someone else's release; touching them is a push into a stranger's account
a user-facing string that says opencode is a product claim; internal identifiers are bloodline, strings are identity
a README line that says opencode must also say fork/upstream/anomalyco/MIT/上游/血缘
